verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; spend is recovering and stabilising.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 116 leads at an average cost of $5.79 per lead, but the most recent 7 days saw a steep drop — leads fell 66.67% week-over-week and cost per lead spiked 83.52%, directly caused by a 38.83% pullback in ad spend. When budgets dip below a certain threshold, platform mechanics push efficiency down fast, which is what happened here. Spend has since recovered to roughly $50–52 per day over the last three days, and lead volume is returning with it. Ten project milestones that underpin tracking, attribution, and campaign expansion are overdue; completing these is the clearest path to more stable, measurable performance in the coming period.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
average cost per lead over the last 28 days
drop in lead volume in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7 days

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead inflated sharply when spend dropped, and 10 project milestones are overdue, limiting how much of your results we can fully track and attribute.
watch_item.fix: Daily spend has been restored to prior levels and is holding — leads are already returning. Overdue milestones are being prioritised now, starting with conversion tracking, which will make next period's numbers fully verifiable.
